name: Glass subscribe button
oneLiner: a watch page on glass (the playing video, its title, the channel row): the white Subscribe pill is pressed, it morphs into the quiet Subscribed pill with a bell, the bell rings with its waves and a count badge while the subscriber number ticks up and bumps
say: when the speaker asks people to subscribe or turn on notifications ('subscribe so you catch the next one', 'hit the bell'): the button is pressed on 'subscribe', the bell rings on 'bell' or 'notified'
